protocol.mapping: Stable unique original actual_candidates mapped by exact public own-command equality to union; preserve first original occurrence order. Never select candidates by future labels or masks. Disclose duplicated actual proposals and original solver choice.
protocol.support: Response:common valid nonanchor point prefixes, group equal after pooling each group's candidate points. Decisions:all candidates in that fixed population and anchor full8step support. Also paired actual/expanded decisions on intersection full-support calls. Different populations never silently treated as same support.
protocol.model_selection: Frozen V15 ADE-median seed for each configuration, selected before V17. Re-infer development only without optimization. All checkpoints remain failed/unpromoted.
protocol.oracle_contract: Future target and exact response only diagnostic information ceilings, not learned or deployable forecasts. No oracle input in public network and no controller activation.

bootstrap.interpretation: Previously inspected V15 train/development groups; descriptive only, not fresh validation or untouched holdout.

protocol.scope: Diagnostic decomposition on already published V15 data; no new model selection, no scene qualification or causal effect identifiability claim. Next training requires separate protocol and fresh groups. Original eight Levels/whole-module off and failure/sequential/self-generated/holdout/closed-loop safety and latency remain required.
